data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 565.942m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, the aggregate prior-year development (for underwriting years up to 2018) shows a net adverse movement of GBP 21.936m (3.88% of opening reserves), i.e. an overall gross strengthening. The movement-note in the accounts reports a net favourable development of GBP 11.6m (net of reinsurance), chiefly reflecting net releases in direct Third Party Liability and reinsurance business; however the gross claims triangle shows mixed development by vintage with significant adverse movement in some years (notably 2016 and 2018) offsetting releases in others. Management highlight opioids/pharma exposures and potential second-order COVID-19 effects as material reserving considerations.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not stated directly in a gross movement note (the movement note reports a net-of-reinsurance favourable movement of GBP 11.6m). A gross PYD was calculated from the published gross claims development (triangle) - this yields a net adverse (strengthening) gross movement of GBP 21.936m. The movement-note figures referenced in the narrative are net of reinsurance and therefore cannot be used as the gross PYD per the extraction rules; lob-level amounts quoted in the movement note appear to be net amounts and have been recorded as such. The Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels was disclosed but described as having no economic impact; the triangle was used with that in mind. Where only net figures were presented in the notes, this has been flagged and gross figures derived from the triangle where possible.
